_comment: sim-place-release-cancel-handshake-v1 (coldwin74/75). Purpose: let the contact-gated weld RELEASE at the cart set-down COMPLETE so the run no longer e-stops with the carton still welded on the shelf. cw74 and cw75 both carried the carton through pick, pre-place and a LEVEL descent onto the cart shelf, and the contact-gated release fired when the support was met (PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE trigger=stall). The release phase then CANCELLED the in-flight place ExecuteTrajectory and WAITED for a terminal result (RESTOCK_RELEASE_CANCEL_SETTLE_S) before detaching -- but the place descent is a DRIVEN trajectory on the sim FollowJointTrajectory executor: the ExecuteTrajectory action cancel is BOTH dropped in the goal-accept race (self.handle is None at the stall, so cancel_goal_async never goes out -- cw75 host-stack.log line 24459, the cancel at sim 245.600 while the goal was only accepted + TRAJ_HOST_START at 246.217) AND unsafe (the sim trajectory_host treats a goal cancel as a FAULT that latches the global /manipulation/stop). cancel_outcome() stayed None for the full budget (cw74 2.0 s, cw75 8.0 s) and HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=release fired. BOTH keys absent/off => the legacy motion.cancel() path => byte-identical.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> TransferController). These keys live UNDER the existing carton_level block (a HOST key, registered in config_preflight).

carton_level._existing: Keep the run's existing carton_level keys (place_contact_release / place_release_on_contact, place_contact_gap_m, closed_loop_*, place_from_above, etc). Only the three keys below are added by this change.
carton_level._release_cancel_handshake_note: Opt-in master switch for the release cancel handshake. When on, the contact-triggered release STOPS the in-flight place descent on its OWN channel: the release phase emits the contact-hold control (/restock_sim/arm_contact=True) so the sim trajectory_host SUCCEEDS holding the current pose (terminal, NO fault, NO global stop), and marks the motion port cancel-requested via settle_in_place() (NOT cancel_goal_async, which is dropped in the goal-accept race and treated as a FAULT by the sim FJT executor). cancel_outcome() then reads the resolved execute future -> 'succeeded' -> gripper-open + detach from the settled pose. Off/absent => the legacy motion.cancel() path (byte-identical, reproduces the cw75 e-stop). PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_CANCEL logs 'hold-and-settle ... on the arm_contact channel'; PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_SETTLED logs the terminal.
carton_level._release_cancel_stopped_vel_note: rad/s. The stopped-arm FALLBACK (belt-and-braces): if the contact-hold terminal STILL never arrives within RESTOCK_RELEASE_CANCEL_SETTLE_S but the arm is PROVABLY stopped -- the measured max joint speed (finite difference of sensors.joint_positions over the sim-time delta) stays at/below this for release_cancel_stopped_ticks CONSECUTIVE ticks -- the release logs RELEASE_CANCEL_STOPPED_FALLBACK with the numbers, forces the port terminal (force_terminal_settled, no e-stop) and proceeds to gripper-open + detach from the stopped pose. NEVER detaches into a moving arm: a joint still advancing above this threshold resets the tick count, so an arm under an active descent never passes the gate. 0.02 rad/s is well below any real descent command and above sensor jitter at rest. Validate the value against the run's at-rest joint noise before loosening.
carton_level._release_cancel_stopped_ticks_note: Consecutive stopped ticks required before the fallback proceeds. >=2 so the fallback is NEVER decided off a single sample (one frozen frame is not proof of a stopped arm). 3 at the ~0.017 s release-phase packet cadence is ~0.05 s of continuous stillness.

_requires: The HOST carton_level block must already carry the contact-gated release (place_release_on_contact:true OR the legacy place_contact_release:true) that FIRES the release at the set-down -- this change only fixes what the release does AFTER it fires. No new --require preflight registration: the keys are parsed by carton_level.resolve_level_config and validated by LevelConfig.validate (a typo fails loudly at boot).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the cw75 config (the full cold restock cycle through the collect cart set-down: ground-truth collect, the carton_level level place descent with place_release_on_contact, closed_loop_sensor, place_from_above) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with release_cancel_handshake:true merged into the HOST carton_level block. Expected PASS (coldwin76): the welded carton descends level onto the shelf, the stall-triggered release fires (PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE trigger=stall) exactly as cw75, then PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_CANCEL logs the arm_contact hold-and-settle, the place descent reaches a terminal within the budget (PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_SETTLED outcome=succeeded, or RELEASE_CANCEL_STOPPED_FALLBACK if the terminal is slow but the arm is stopped), the gripper-open DETACHES the weld, and the run advances to retreat/stow/verify -- NO HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=release with the carton welded on the shelf. If the handshake terminal AND the stopped-arm fallback both miss (the arm genuinely never stops), the release still fails fast by name ('... the arm never read stopped within <t>s sim -- not detaching into an in-flight planning scene'), never a blind detach into a moving arm.
